q: The Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for randomness checks whether a sample comes from a hypothesized distribution by comparing:
opts: The mean and variance to theoretical values
The empirical CDF to the theoretical CDF, bounding the supremum norm
The entropy of the sample to the theoretical entropy
exp: The KS test uses the supremum norm ||F_n − F||_∞ between empirical and theoretical CDFs. By the Glivenko-Cantelli theorem, this converges to 0 a.s. for i.i.d. samples from F.
